title: Cosmic Blue Oracle
description: A majestic blue female android sits in a meditative pose against a cosmic landscape. Her body is composed of intricate glowing golden grid patterns and embedded blue diamonds, with a radiant halo of light and floating diamond fragments surrounding her head as she holds a small glowing cube in her hand.
prompt: A majestic blue female android with intricate golden wireframe and grid patterns sits in a meditative pose in a surreal cosmic landscape. Her body features glowing blue diamonds, she has luminous golden eyes, and a radiant halo of light with floating diamond fragments orbits her head. She holds a small glowing golden cube in her palm. Dramatic aurora borealis, starry night sky, mountains made of glowing wireframe grids, beams of golden light descending from above, mystical and ethereal atmosphere.
